Game Overview

Italian Brainrot Neuro Beasts is a clicker title where dive into a whimsical world of neural chaos. Collect and upgrade quirky neuro-beasts inspired by Italian charm. Click, earn neuron chips and pizza, and climb the leaderboard. Engage with other players, share strategies, and embrace the madness of surreal creatures and endless fun. Can you master the Neuro-Pizza realm?
